title: A staff update carrying technician false is accepted and ignores it
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Have a valid Public API key for the test organization, the Public API documentation for staff, and a request tool (Postman or any tool that sends requests with that key).
  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Note staff member A's id as the Public API gives it (from GET /api/v1/staff).
  • Choose a new phone number for staff member A.
custom_steps:
1. Send PATCH /api/v1/staff/<staff member A's id> with the API key, with the new phone number and "technician": false.
  2. Open Settings, Staff in the app.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The update succeeds, as today.
  • The record returned has the new phone number.
  • The record returned has "technician": true (the value sent was ignored).

Step 2:

  • Staff member A's row still shows "Yes" in the Technician column.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11883 (Story 5, Public API - technician value on staff)

  • S5-N1: “The technician value cannot be set through the Public API. A staff update that includes it succeeds as today and ignores that value; the record returned carries the value worked out by S5-R1.”

From: Technician Toggle technical implementation plan, 28 Oct 2026, written for PRD version 9 (sources/tech-plan-Technician-Toggle-2026-11-02.md; QA lead 2 Nov 2026: "No newer plan; go ahead"); quoted only where it still matches PRD version 17, read 2 Nov 2026

  • Tech plan: “**API**: with a Public API token, `GET /api/v1/staff` → `technician` present. A PATCH with it is ignored.”
